title: Jati hai madina zainab
body:
Haaye(2) ..chali Jo shaam se  watan zainab to lab pa the ye bain...
Ay  karbalaey sarware dilgeer  alwida..
Ay  qatl-e-gahe hazrate Shabbeer alwida
Ay  khabre Ibne sahebe tatheer alvida....
Ay  bhai jaan jati hai hamsheer alvida..
Kya gham naseeb hai ye nawasi rasool ki
Tum ne mujaveri na hamari qubool ki...
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
KEHTI THI YE QABRE SHEH PER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
Bhaiyya mein bataon kaise...
Jo zakhm mile rahon mein
Hamrah thai jitna bacche
gir gir ke mare rahon mein
Kuch kar na saki ye khwar (2)...
Jati hai madina zainab s.a
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
Haton mein mihar onthon ki
aur aale-nabi nange sarr
Lohe ki giran zanjeeren
sajjad ka jisme laghar
So100 tarha ke gham ek dil par(2)..
Jati hai madina zainab s.a...
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
Bhulege na hargiz zainab bazaare sitam ka manzar
Har samth tamashaiye thai har gaam Naye ek thokar
Thi aale nabi be chadaar(2)
jati hai madina  zainab s.a...
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
Zindan se chuht kar bhai
Chehlum tere  karne ayei
Pardais mein aakar bhai
Zainab ko mili tanhaei
Ye daagh bada hai dil par (2)
Jati hai madina zainab s.a...
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
Zindan mein sakina Teri
Duniya se gayi faqon se
Kis tarha usse  dafnaya
Abid  ne  bandhe haaton se
Barpa tha wahan ik mehsharr (2)
Jati hai madina zainab s.a...
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
Hamrah mere hai bhaiyya
Tera  khoon Bhara wo  kurta
Rassi ke nishan hain taza
Dikhlaongi wo bhi bhaiyya
Amma ki lahed per jakar (2)
Jati hai Madina zainab s.a...
UJDA HUWA KUNBA LE KER JATI HAI MADINA ZAINAB...S.A (2)
Qaisar tha bapa ik mehshar
Shozab ne padha jab noha
Zehra s.a ki sada ye ayei
Ta hashr raho tum zinda
Har saal padho ye rokar (2)
Jati hai madeena zainab s.a...
